params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the heading.

params.name: text
params.description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text for the heading.

params.name: html
params.description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML for the heading.

params.name: visuallyHiddenText
params.description: Optional visually hidden prefix used before the heading.

params.name: size
params.description: Size of the heading – `"xxs"`, `"xs"`, `"s"`, `"m"`, `"l"` or `"xl"`.

params.name: level
params.description: Optional heading level. Defaults to `2`.

params.name: classes
params.description: Classes to add to the heading.

params.name: attributes
params.description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the heading.

name: clickable
description: If set to `true`, then the whole card will become a clickable card variant.

name: image
description: Can be used to add an image to the card component.

params.name: src
params.description: The URL of the image in the card.

params.name: alt
params.description: The alternative text of the image in the card.

params.name: html
params.description: HTML to use for the image content. If `html` is provided, the `src` and `alt` options will be ignored.

name: description
description: Description to use within the card content. If `descriptionHtml` is provided, the `description` option will be ignored.

params.name: text
params.description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text to use within the card content. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML to use within the card content. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: classes
params.description: Classes to add to the card content.

params.name: attributes
params.description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the card content.

name: actions
description: Can be used to add actions to the card component.

params.name: items
params.description: Array of actions as links for use in the card component.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the action item.

params.name: text
params.description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text to use within each action item. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML to use within each action item. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: visuallyHiddenText
params.description: Actions rely on context from the surrounding content so may require additional accessible text. Text supplied to this option is appended to the end. Use `html` for more complicated scenarios.

params.name: name
params.description: Name for the action as a button. If `href` is provided, this has no effect.

params.name: type
params.description: Type of action as a button – `"button"`, `"submit"` or `"reset"`. Defaults to `"submit"` unless `href` is provided.

params.name: value
params.description: The `value` attribute for the action as a button. If `href` is provided, this has no effect.

params.name: href
params.description: The action `href` attribute. If set, the action will use an `<a>` tag automatically unless `type` is provided.

params.name: classes
params.description: Classes to add to the action item.

params.name: attributes
params.description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the action item.

params.name: classes
params.description: Classes to add to the actions wrapper.

name: caller
description: Not strictly an option but supports the [`call` block](https://mozilla.github.io/nunjucks/templating.html#call) as an alternative to the `html` option. To use it, you will need to wrap the entire card component in a `call` block.

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the card.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the card.
